title: October Townhall: Product + Roadmap Updates
summary: Join the LiteLLM October townhall on Thursday, 22 October at 7:30 AM PT to learn about LiteLLM's product updates and roadmap.
body_markdown:
We are hosting our October townhall on **Thursday, 22 October at 7:30 AM PT** .


## Agenda​


- **Security.** This month's fixes and the hardening work behind them.
- **Stability**


- **Bug fixes.** The month's count, and where they landed.
- **Rust path.** The messages and responses APIs.
- **Performance.** Where the gateway got faster.


- **Product**


- **Lens.** Trace agent runs, investigate recurring failures.
- **Moyai.** Open source coding agents in your cloud.
- **LiteLLM Relay.** Point company Macs at the gateway.
- **Claude Code and Codex.** SSO and per-user spend through the gateway.
- **Decisions API.** Typed questions on` /v1/decisions` .
- **Auto Router.** What changed since September.


- **Open Q&A.** Bring your questions for the team.


## Stability​


Our team is focused on stability: improving reliability and reducing regressions across releases. Follow the roadmap here:[Stability roadmap](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/30484) .


## How to contribute​


Add the topics and questions you'd like us to cover when you register below. We use your responses to set the agenda.


## Register​


Register here:[LiteLLM October Townhall Form](https://forms.gle/F8tTYR8rfjKBA4D67)


We will hold the townhall from **7:30 AM to 8:30 AM PT on Zoom** .


For security, attendance is restricted to corporate emails. If you register with a non-corporate email, we will share the townhall slides and accompanying blog post after the event.
